Select IC50 activity records for the single-protein target Beta-secretase 1 identified by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4822. Return compound_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), canonical_smiles (from compound_structures, INNER JOIN required, exclude nulls), compound_key (from compound_records), pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer docs.pubmed_id, fallback to docs.doi; exclude nulls), assay_description (from assays.description), standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id (from target_dictionary.chembl_id), target_name (from target_dictionary.pref_name), target_organism (from target_dictionary.organism). Join path: activities -> assays on assay_id -> target_dictionary on assays.tid, activities -> compound_records on activities.record_id -> docs on compound_records.doc_id, activities -> molecule_dictionary on activities.molregno -> compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno. Filter: target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4822', activities.standard_type = 'IC50'. Keep all qualifying activity rows; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
